head: https://worldx-website-cdn.aniimo.com/official-website/worldx/wiki_stage/init/Wiki_PetHead_10541.png

skills.name: Water Orb
skills.description: Launch a Water Ball forward.

skills.name: Thoughtful Service
skills.description: The final hit of a Basic Attack marks the target on the farther side with [Sludge]. Hitting the marked side with a skill removes it, dealing damage equal to 35 Might, and heals the caster for 3% Max HP.

skills.name: Sludge Clearing
skills.description: The final hit of a Basic Attack marks the target on the side farther from the caster with [Sludge]. When a skill hits the [Sludge] side, removes [Sludge], deals damage equal to 35 Might, and applies 6 stacks of [Water Debuff].

skills.name: Frogs Love Baths
skills.description: Swings forward to deal 3 hits of damage. If the target has at least 10 stacks of [Water Debuff], consumes 3 stacks to increase this skill’s Might by 35%.

skills.name: Limber-Up Rapid Kicks
skills.description: Unleashes consecutive flying kicks forward, and restores 3% of own max HP.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: Wields the power of water to attack targets at close range.

name: Scrubbit
description: Though it’s round and chubby, Scrubbit is surprisingly nimble. That shed long tail-leaf in its hands is both a scrub towel for washing its body and a sharp tool for whipping opponents.

name: Salabask
description: Salabask’s head looks like a piece of driftwood covered in moss. It loves soaking in the water with only its head above the surface, basking in the sun. Sometimes other Aniimo mistake it for a floating plank to cross the river, and one careless step can knock it out cold.
head: https://worldx-website-cdn.aniimo.com/official-website/worldx/wiki_stage/init/Wiki_PetHead_10601.png

skills.name: Withered Wood Rot
skills.description: When dealing Skill Damage or Ultimate Damage to the target, reduces the target’s Grass Resistance by 17% for 10s.

skills.name: Spring Renewal
skills.description: Creates a Withered Wood zone underfoot, granting allied deployed Aniimo 16% Damage Reduction. Also, heals the deployed Grass-type Aniimo for 1% of the caster’s Max HP each second for 20s.

skills.name: Gatorjaw Bite
skills.description: Pulls the target in front, then sprays forward, applying [Withered Wood Attachment] to 1 hit target for 15s. When a target with [Withered Wood Attachment] takes 5 instances of Grass-type Damage, triggers an AoE blast at the target’s location equal to 30 Might.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: Wields the power of grass to attack targets at close range.

name: Crocobask
description: It loves to float motionless on the river’s surface, soaking up the sun, and doesn’t mind being used like driftwood to step across. Just don’t stand on its back too long. It might suddenly flip over.

name: Puffby
description: It flits busily through the night, gathering pollen from glowing plants and carefully rolling it into pretty pollen balls to bring back to the hive. When danger strikes, it swings the pollen ball like a weapon to bash its enemies.
head: https://worldx-website-cdn.aniimo.com/official-website/worldx/wiki_stage/init/Wiki_PetHead_10611.png

skills.name: Honeydew Hauling
skills.description: Hitting a target with a skill generates Honeydew that only the caster can pick up. Picking it up restores 4 Energy. After picking up 4 of them, Break Damage dealt is increased by 70%. However, using skills additionally costs 10 Energy, and hits will no longer generate [Honeydew]. These effects last 8s.

skills.name: Bee-Powered Tackle
skills.description: Charges at the target.

skills.name: Pollen Ball Slam
skills.description: Swings a Pollen Ball and smashes it into the target, dealing massive damage.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: (BREAK) Wields the power of wind to attack targets at close range.

name: Buffby
description: A burly powerhouse with exceptional strength but none of the brute attitude, it’s gentle at heart and meticulous in action. It patrols tirelessly around the hive, day and night, protecting the swarm.
head: https://worldx-website-cdn.aniimo.com/official-website/worldx/wiki_stage/init/Wiki_PetHead_10613.png

name: Royalby
description: The queen of the swarm and the hive’s highest ruler, she is revered by her kin and lives within the royal nest the workers craft for her, commanding the entire swarm.
head: https://worldx-website-cdn.aniimo.com/official-website/worldx/wiki_stage/init/Wiki_PetHead_10614.png

skills.name: Queen’s Protection
skills.description: Royalby restores 4 EP when casting a skill. When its own skill damages a target, it restores 2 EP.

skills.name: Queen’s Blessing
skills.description: Restores HP to all allied Wind-type Aniimo. The amount restored equals 9% Max HP of the caster. If [Queen’s Domain] is expanded, it applies to all allies’ Wind-type Aniimo within the domain.

skills.name: Royal Pressure
skills.description: Expands [Queen’s Domain]. When the Wind-type Aniimo switched in uses a skill, it triggers the domain, dealing damage to targets within range. The trigger interval is no less than 0.5s, and the domain lasts 20s.

skills.name: Puffby Bomb
skills.description: Summons a Puffby to move forward. When it reaches the end of the skill path, it drops a Pollen Puff to deal damage and [stun] the target for for 1.5s. Cast the skill again to make it drop the Pollen Puff early.

skills.name: Puff Lightshot
skills.description: Summons a Puffby to move forward. When it reaches the set distance, Puffby drops a Pollen Puff, dealing damage. In addition, within 20s, the target loses 10 Energy upon Aniimo switch. Cast the skill again to drop the Pollen Puff early.

skills.name: All Shall Bow to the Crown
skills.description: Restores 8 Energy per second and Twines up to 5 targets within 4 meters, reducing their Movement Speed by 35% and draining 8 Energy per second. If a target is still within range after 3 seconds, it takes Damage and is inflicted with [Stun]3 seconds.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: Wields the power of wind to attack targets from a distance.

skills.name: Surging Wave

skills.name: Wavebreaker Shark Rush

skills.name: High-Speed Cut

name: Prawnch
description: Prawnch trains hard in the rapids, raising its claw-fists high and picking fights with every opponent in sight. It even treats passing creatures as imaginary enemies. The more it gets ignored, the more it itches to throw down.

skills.name: Knuckle Burst
skills.description: The first time a skill hits a target, gains 1 Strike Points. After charging, the skill’s first hit grants 2 points. After accumulating 6 Strike Points, enters [Knuckle Burst] for 6s. During [Knuckle Burst], skills can be enhanced without charging, and the first time a skill hits a target, it applies 2 stacks of [Ice Debuff].

skills.name: Spring Fist
skills.description: Compresses the pincer-arm spring to charge up, then throws 3 punches. Each hit can trigger the trait effect. Charging increases the attack range and Might by 30%. The 1st and 2nd charged attacks knock the target back; after the 3rd charged attack hits, dashes forward.

skills.name: Spring Combo
skills.description: Tenses up the pincer arms to charge, then throws a flurry of punches forward; can move while attacking. Deals extra damage equal to 20% Might to targets with more than 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff]. Charging increases the attack range, and the number of attacks by 30%.
